text:
alex_devex: Heads up — publish to npm for @redwood/sdk-js 0.9.4 broke edge envs. Edge apps getting SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'. Likely .cjs/.mjs mismatch and missing sourcemaps. Example error:
```
SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'
    at Object.exports.runInContext (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:999:18)
    at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1072:14)
```

mike_build: Repro'd locally in node:16+ with an edge runtime shim. The package.json "module" points to dist/index.mjs but dist/index.mjs is missing; only dist/index.cjs is in the tarball. Also no .map files shipped.

jordan_ts: That's probably the rollup change from last week — we only emit cjs for the node target unless `output.format` includes 'es'. The publish job used the node pipeline by accident.

alex_devex: Workaround for customers: pin to 0.9.3 for now or use a bundler alias to the cjs entry. Not great for ESM-only edge runtimes though.

sam_ci-bot: @alex_devex opened hotfix branch: refs/pull/4125. Release job failed the source-map step because `dist/*.map` glob returned empty and we skip artifact attach silently.

lee_releases: I'm doing a quick republish: building locally with `npm run build:es && npm pack` to inspect package contents before npm publish. Will push a 0.9.5-hotfix if this fixes it.

ana_typing: Also noticed types are missing in the ESM output: `dist/types/index.d.ts` wasn't emitted for the es build. Type-only emit needs to run for both bundles. If we don't include types consumers in TS projects will see module not found errors.

mike_build: Action items I noted: 1) Fix rollup/tsup config to output both .mjs and .cjs; 2) Ensure source maps are generated and included in the npm package; 3) Update package.json exports map so `import` resolves to .mjs and `require` to .cjs; 4) Add npm smoke test to CI: `node -e "(async()=>{const r=await import('redwood-sdk-js');console.log(Object.keys(r));})();"` to catch broken packs.

jordan_ts: I'll add a step in the release workflow to run `npm pack` and validate expected files are present (`dist/index.mjs`, `dist/index.cjs`, `dist/*.map`, `dist/types/**`). Also add a lint that fails if package.json exports point to files that don't exist.

alex_devex: Please ping the #customers channel after publish. We already have 3 edge customers who hit errors in prod. :frown: 

lee_releases: Published 0.9.5-hotfix at 1790123476. Verified `npm pack` contains dist/index.mjs, dist/index.cjs, .map files, and types. I also backfilled a short smoke test in the release job.

jordan_ts: PR 4127 updates CI and release checklist: includes `npm pack` validation and a `node --input-type=module` smoke test for ESM resolution.

ana_typing: Follow-up: added `emitDeclarationOnly` run separate for ESM output and copied types into `dist/es` to avoid missing d.ts in the packed tree.

alex_devex: Thanks all. I'll message affected customers and monitor PostHog for regressions. If anyone sees stray reports, drop logs here and tag me. :pray:
